agents.name: Frontend
agents.title: Booking UI

options.kickoff: Create the booking UI notes, one file at a time, in this order: notes/1-calendar.md, notes/2-slot-picker.md, notes/3-confirmation.md, notes/4-errors.md, notes/5-a11y.md, notes/6-mobile.md. Each file: a heading and 3 short bullet points. Use the Write tool once per file. If an office message arrives while you work, handle it right away, then continue with the files.

lessons: Our rule: the API sends UTC ISO timestamps plus the clinic's IANA time zone; the UI converts to clinic local time. The Sydney clinic complained about raw UTC in v0.

options.kickoff: Ask Frontend: should slot start times in the slots API be local time or UTC? Then wait for the answer and tell PM the decision in one sentence with inform.
